name: project-state-plugin
description: The project-state marketplace — project ops, compliance, and grant-management skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: project-state
plugins.description: Turn any multi-stakeholder project into a system where routine reporting is a byproduct of normal work. 43 skills + 8 swappable compliance packs + 2 capability plugins (Canadian SR&ED, tender intelligence).

plugins.name: demo-forge
plugins.description: Build and maintain project-state's self-driving demo decks and their narration. demo-audio re-bakes deck voiceover with OpenAI TTS (gpt-4o-mini-tts / nova) — archive-first, key-safe, deploy + verify; demo-deck scaffolds a route-validated, share-wired feature / clip / flow and renders its audio.

plugins.name: voice-forge
plugins.description: Give any deck, page, or walkthrough a voice. voice-cast auditions voices before you pay for a render; voice-render bakes the script to canned audio with OpenAI TTS (manifest-driven, hash-skips unchanged segments); voice-embed wires an opt-in player that follows the slide; voice-caption ships WebVTT captions and a transcript. Canned rather than live, so it costs nothing at runtime and screen recorders capture it.
